nodes.dialogue_text: Come away, O King. The stench here is unbearable. Your brothers are suffering for their sins, but a place of eternal joy awaits you above.

choices.choice_text: Return to your heaven, Indra. The company of my brothers in this foul pit is sweeter to me than any heaven shared with Duryodhana.

nodes.dialogue_text: He left his brothers in the pit, and heaven was cold. This is not the road that was written.
Well done, Yudhishthira! You have passed the final test. Kings must see hell if even for a moment. Plunge into the heavenly Ganga and cast off this mortal frame forever.
